lastCompletedStory.title: Render per-phase backend in ConfigScreen and persist per-phase keys

nextStoryContext: US-003 widened ConfigChoices.backend from `string` to `Record<Phase, string>` in ConfigScreen.tsx, mirroring `models`/`efforts`. Backend is now a per-phase Select rendered on EVERY phase tab (PhaseTabContent), appended after model+effort as the last field (index 2 for the 5 LLM phases, index 1 for Ship which has no effort field) via a new `backendFieldIndex(phase)` helper; fieldCountForTab changed from {global:5, ship:1, llm:2} to {global:4, ship:2, llm:3} since the Backend Section was fully removed from GlobalTabContent (Global's remaining 4 fields shifted down by one: merge-mode=0, plan-approval=1, notify-recipient=2, notify-from=3). mergeConfigChoices (config.ts) now writes `[backend]` as one key per phase (`backend: choices.backend as TomlSection`), replacing the old `{ name: choices.backend }` scalar-wrapper; readPhaseBackend's existing US-001 fallback chain (per-phase key -> legacy name/scalar -> DEFAULTS.backend) reads both shapes, so no reader migration was needed. printConfigShow collapsed its old 7-row table (6 phases + 1 trailing global 'backend' row) into a single 3-column table (phase/model/backend) via readPhaseModel+readPhaseBackend per row. All 5 config-related test files were updated to match (config-screen.test.tsx's TOTAL_FIELD_COUNT is now 21 = 5*3+2+4). src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts (BackendAdapter/ClaudeAdapter.buildSpawnArgv) remains untouched by US-001/US-002/US-003 -- still the seam for a future story wiring actual per-backend spawn-argv behavior (e.g. codex support). This was the final story of the CAM-349 PRD's currently-listed scope per the notes on US-001/US-002; check prd.json for any remaining stories before assuming the PRD is complete.
